title: Cymbals he uses now
summary: On a later tape, Williams says he uses 21-inch Turkish cymbals and that drummers differ in their choices.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: We were talking about your drum set again. How big a cymbal do you use now? What kind
of cymbals do you have now? I use a 21 inch cymbals.

Yeah, they're zinyin. The Turkish cymbals, that was run around 14, 22 or 21 inch too. Now that's what we use now. The regular good cymbals, most of the drummers, all the drummers don't use the same thing.
If you want to answer the phone number.
No, she can actually talk to me. Don't worry.
